verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document launching multiple autonomous agents to work in parallel on different tasks. It covers related pieces only. Goals keep a single session working across turns, subagents are configurable roles inside one agent, and headless `runMC` can be embedded in scripts. Running a fleet from these would be a user-built workaround or developer building block, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days
